title_zh: 找到旧咖啡机滤纸的另一销售渠道

scenario.label_zh: 找到旧咖啡机滤纸的另一销售渠道
scenario.goal_zh: 说明滤纸尺寸特殊造成的购买困难，并确定先联系另一销售点核实库存

context_zh: 顾客带着旧咖啡机的滤纸包装向五金杂货店店员询问。
author: author-phase11-c

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: These filters are a peculiar size. The usual ones fold over the edge of my old coffee maker.

sentences.speaker: Gus
sentences.text: Have you tried the merchant at the indoor market? She sells parts for older machines.

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: I thought the original manufacturer had a monopoly on these filters.

sentences.speaker: Gus
sentences.text: Not on selling them. The market shop is another outlet, although I don’t know what it has in stock today.

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: Do you have the shop’s number? I’d rather call before I cross town.

sentences.speaker: Gus
sentences.text: Yes, it’s on this market directory. Ask for the size printed on your packet.

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: Perfect. I’ll call and check that size first.
